architectural_determination: The exposure boundary is frozen before implementation. The future adapter may see only frozen case IDs and prompts, must use the already certified productive H6 entry path, must isolate cases, must capture exactly one unscored response per case and must never load ground truth. This gate performs no held-out exposure. Implementation is blocked until RED isolation contract tests exist.
next_gate: HCPDQ-v2 H6 ROBY Evaluation Run — Pre-Execution RED / Isolation Contract Tests

protocol.case_isolation: fresh evaluation context per case; no prior held-out response is provided to a later case
protocol.failure_policy: route failure, exception or incomplete capture is recorded as-is; no retry or repair during exposure
protocol.ground_truth_boundary: ground-truth file is not loaded, passed, imported or exposed by the exposure adapter
protocol.input_surface: case_id plus frozen prompt only; prompt delivered unchanged through the certified productive H6 conversation entry path
protocol.learning_policy: learning, adaptation, memory writeback and benchmark feedback prohibited during exposure
protocol.mutation_policy: corpus, ground truth, prompts and captured responses are immutable
protocol.response_capture: capture one immutable response record per case_id without scoring
protocol.retry_policy: exactly one attempt per case; retries prohibited
protocol.scoring_policy: no scoring, labels, expected decisions or ground-truth comparison during exposure
